entities.name: Vlado Janković
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Vladimir "Vlado" Janković is a Serbian–Greek professional basketball player and the team captain for Peristeri of the Greek Basketball League. Standing at 2.02 m, he mainly plays at the small forward position. He is the son of the late Serbian professional basketball player Boban Janković.
